description: Election Commission - Declare that M. A. M. Siyath as a member of the Manmunai Pattu P/S - Declare that M. M. A. Rahuman and A. M. Fizer as member of the Kattankudy UC
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government councils (Manmunai Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha and Kattankudy Urban Council) due to resignations, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including candidate nominations and declarations by the Returning Officer, which falls under the Elections category.
